history.sg_progress: The Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs is undergoing significant global restructuring and workforce reduction due to funding constraints. Nevertheless, the Office will develop a draft plan and timeline to transition UNDP- administered staff into the United Nations Secretariat. The implementation of this plan will follow a phased regional approach to mitigate risks and ensure operational continuity. This recommendation is in line with phase II of the OHCHR project to transition staff from UNDP-administered contracts to Secretariat-administered contracts. Specifically, it calls for the conversion of all UNDP-administered service contractors working on behalf of OHCHR to individual contractor or consultancy contracts.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that entities with UNDP-administered staff develop their transition plans by 30 June 2026, as envisioned by the Administration, duly taking into consideration all the potential financial implications and the availability of the funding in this regard.
history.administration_response: The Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs is undergoing a major restructuring and reduction in its workforce globally given funding constraints. As a result, this recommendation was put on hold and will be revisited after the completion of the exercise, which is also impacting locally-recruited personnel administered by UNDP. Upon completion of the exercise, the Office will develop a working plan, in liaison with the Office of Human Resources, for the integration of the remaining UNDP-administered staff into the Secretariat. A phased regional approach to the implementation of the plan will be taken to minimize disruption to the ongoing operations of the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs. The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights has established a transition plan and will commence implementation once approved. Registering incumbent staff in the Umoja enterprise resource planning platform, through the transition from UNDP to Secretariat- administered contracts, is fundamental to operationalizing the General Assembly-endorsed regionalization strategy for the Office.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs is undergoing a large restructuring and reduction in its workforce globally given the funding constraints, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
